metadata.title: The Karma Contract of the Midnight Villa
metadata.subtitle: His mistress bribed a crooked doctor to trick me into signing away the estate—on the lunar eclipse, the dead matriarch locked every exit.

nodes.text: 11:36 PM · Lakeside Villa under a blood-red lunar eclipse. While Julian is stranded at an overseas summit, Camille arrives uninvited with private physician Dr. Vance.
Drink your chamomile tea, Elise. Dr. Vance says your "stress spells" mean you need to sign over temporary power of attorney for the Lakeside Villa tonight.
Purely standard medical guardianship, Mrs. Elise. Once you drink the calming tea and initial page four, you can rest.
How thoughtful. You two slipped three crushed sedative tablets into my cup and thought I wouldn’t notice the chalky ring on the rim?

nodes.prompt: You tip the spiked tea straight into the potted fern behind the sofa:

options.label: Warn them about the eclipse smart-lock
options.player_reply_text: My late mother-in-law programmed this villa’s biometric doors to seal shut during any unauthorized transfer. Look at the red moon outside.

options.label: Trigger the silent panic beacon to Julian
options.player_reply_text: Too bad I tapped the silent panic ring under the dining table five minutes ago. Every microphone in this house is streaming straight to Julian.

nodes.text: The old woman has been dead two years! Dr. Vance, grab the pen—she’s signing that deed before midnight one way or another!
Camille?! Dr. Vance?! I’m listening LIVE from my hotel in Frankfurt—if either of you touches Elise, I’m calling the police chief right now!
11:44 PM · CLANG! Every titanium deadbolt in the Lakeside Villa slams shut simultaneously as the lunar eclipse hits totality. The fireplace flames turn ice-blue.

nodes.headline: Total Eclipse Lockdown
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The dead Matriarch’s intercom snaps on—locking Camille and Dr. Vance inside their own trap.

nodes.text: 11:48 PM · You step calmly behind the reinforced glass sliding door of the upstairs gallery while Camille and Dr. Vance pound on the locked mahogany front doors.
The manual override lever won’t budge! Why is the fireplace roaring ice-blue when the gas valve is shut off?!
Unlock the doors, Elise!! Who is speaking over the upstairs intercom—that sounds just like Julian’s dead mother!!
Wait... I can hear it on the live stream too! Mother’s voice just said: "No thief leaves my villa with dry feet." Police are twelve minutes away, Elise—stay upstairs!

nodes.prompt: Dr. Vance tries to smash the kitchen patio glass with a brass poker:

options.label: Remind him it’s hurricane-rated glass
options.player_reply_text: Save your wrists, Dr. Vance. That glass stops ninety-mile winds—and the poker just burned your palm, didn’t it?

options.label: Ask about the sedative dosage he brought
options.player_reply_text: Tell Julian on the open mic, Dr. Vance: how much sedative did Camille pay you to put in my nightly vitamins all month?

nodes.text: AAH!! The handle froze solid to my fingers! Camille, you told me this was an easy $500,000 payout!
Only mild sleeping pills! I swear I didn’t want to overdose you—Camille was the one who demanded double doses tonight!

nodes.headline: Double Dose Confessed
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Camille turns on Dr. Vance—and their getaway car outside starts rolling toward the lake.

nodes.text: 11:57 PM · Rain pours down under the crimson eclipse. Inside the sealed foyer, Camille shoves Dr. Vance against the marble staircase.
Shut your mouth, Vance!! You’re the one who forged the psychiatric evaluation claiming Elise was mentally incompetent!
Because you promised to clear my malpractice lawsuit once you got the Lakeside Villa deed!! Wait—why is my car alarm going off outside?!
I’m watching the driveway camera from Frankfurt! Your parked SUV’s handbrake just disengaged—it’s rolling straight into the mudbank by the lake!

nodes.prompt: Dr. Vance’s backup phone—the one synced to his car GPS—drops onto the foyer rug:

options.label: Remind them police are tracking every signal
options.player_reply_text: Looks like your getaway ride just sank axle-deep into Mother’s lotus marsh, Doctor.

options.label: Ask Julian to alert police to the trunk
options.player_reply_text: Julian, tell the responding sergeant to secure Dr. Vance’s SUV trunk the second they reach the gate—the bribe ledger is inside.

nodes.text: My medical bag and the original bribe ledger are in that trunk!!
Already relayed to the sergeant! They’re six minutes from the main gate.

nodes.headline: Sinking Into the Marsh
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Dr. Vance’s shattered GPS screen flashes a chilling location pin.

nodes.text: 12:06 AM · Julian captures a still from the villa’s smart-hub telemetry showing Dr. Vance’s cracked tracking device pinged deep in the marsh.

nodes.caption: No escape route left, Elise. Every road out of the lake peninsula is already blocked by patrol units.

nodes.text: Julian, please listen to me!! Elise trapped us in here—I only came to check on her health!!
Save your breath, Camille! I just heard you scream about double-dosing my wife’s tea and forging a psychiatric report!

nodes.prompt: Camille drops to her knees on the foyer rug as the blue fire flares higher:

options.label: Ask who wrote the estate transfer contract
options.player_reply_text: You couldn’t draft a twenty-page real-estate guardianship deed alone, Camille. Who’s your inside lawyer?

options.label: Demand the original signed tea-drugging texts
options.player_reply_text: Leave your unlocked phone on the foyer table, Camille—the police will want your chat with Dr. Vance.

nodes.text: It was Grant—the junior paralegal at Julian’s family office! He copied your late mother-in-law’s trust format!
I’ll hand over my own chat backups right now! Just please tell the intercom to stop whispering my name!!

nodes.headline: The Inside Paralegal
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Red-and-blue patrol lights reflect off the lake as the Matriarch’s doors finally unlock.

nodes.text: 12:15 AM · Three patrol SUVs sweep down the cypress drive. The moment the lead officer steps onto the porch, the titanium deadbolts glide smoothly open.
Sergeant Cole is inside the foyer now, Elise. You can safely come down the gallery stairs.
Officer, bag the potted fern soil behind the sofa too—I poured the spiked chamomile tea straight into it, and there’s still powder on the cup rim.
I’ll cooperate fully with the prosecutor... Camille threatened to leak my clinic’s old billing errors if I refused!

nodes.prompt: Officers cuff both Camille and Dr. Vance in the foyer:

options.label: Point officers to the forged deed on the table
options.player_reply_text: Don’t forget the twenty-page guardianship contract sitting beside the teacup, Sergeant. Grant’s metadata is still in the print footer.

options.label: Recover the bribe ledger from the marsh SUV
options.player_reply_text: Have the second unit winch Dr. Vance’s SUV out of the mud and seal that briefcase before water ruins the ink.

nodes.text: Sergeant Cole just confirmed Grant’s employee print ID is stamped on every page! They’re sending a unit to Grant’s apartment now.
Briefcase recovered bone-dry! The ledger lists every wire Camille sent since January.

nodes.headline: The Eclipse Passes
nodes.teaser_text: Next: As the red shadow slips off the moon, the blue hearth fire flickers back to warm gold.

nodes.text: 12:55 AM · The lunar eclipse clears into bright silver moonlight. At the precinct, paralegal Grant breaks down within ten minutes of questioning.
Grant just confessed, Elise—Camille promised him $300,000 to slip a fake guardianship amendment into our family trust.
Good thing your mother built this house to protect its rightful mistress. Are you getting on the first flight home?
Already cleared security in Frankfurt—I’ll be through the Lakeside gates by breakfast. And Elise, I’m firing the entire external trust firm tomorrow.

nodes.prompt: Sergeant Cole sends a request for your digital signature on the evidence receipt:

options.label: Sign and press maximum felony charges
options.player_reply_text: Signed. Zero plea bargains for anyone who tries to drug a woman in her own home.

options.label: Request a copy of the forged contract scan
options.player_reply_text: Send me the certified scan of the forged deed too—I want it archived in the family vault as a reminder.

nodes.text: Backed 100%. Our chief counsel is filing the civil fraud suit at 8 AM sharp too.
Sending the certified scan over right now!

nodes.headline: The Certified Forgery
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The forensic scan of the guardianship deed seals all three indictments.

nodes.text: 1:30 AM · You review the certified forensic scan of the guardianship contract on your tablet beside the warm hearth.

nodes.caption: Case closed, Elise. Toxicology confirmed triple-strength sedatives in the fern soil, and the forged deed links all three.

nodes.text: All three denied bail?
Every single one of them. Attempted drugging, conspiracy to commit grand estate fraud, and medical malpractice.

nodes.prompt: You look up at your late mother-in-law’s portrait above the warm fireplace:

options.label: Whisper a quiet thank-you to her
options.player_reply_text: Thank you for locking the doors tonight, Mother. Your home is safe.

options.label: Brew fresh peppermint tea in a clean pot
options.player_reply_text: Time to throw out every box of chamomile in the pantry and brew fresh peppermint.

nodes.text: A gentle crackle pops from the golden oak embers—warm, calm, and completely still.
Fresh peppermint steam rises in the quiet kitchen as silver moonlight shimmers on the lake.

nodes.headline: Warm Hearth at 2 AM
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Before dawn, the smart-home engineer inspects the villa’s lock logs—and makes a baffling discovery.

nodes.text: 4:45 AM · Early morning security technicians inspect the Lakeside Villa smart-locks and intercom system.
Just landed! The lead technician texted me the strangest report—he says our villa intercom circuit has been disconnected since Mother passed two years ago.
And the titanium deadbolts?
No remote command, no power surge—the log simply reads: "OVERRIDE AUTHORIZED BY MATRIARCH."

nodes.prompt: Julian’s car turns onto the lakeside peninsula road as the sky turns amber:

options.label: Smile and unlock the front portico
options.player_reply_text: Come home, Julian. I’ll meet you on the front steps.

options.label: Keep Mother’s portrait illuminated at dawn
options.player_reply_text: Tell the technician not to touch a single wire on that intercom. Some blessings should stay untouched.

nodes.text: Two minutes away—can’t wait to hold you, Elise.
Agreed. Mother always loved you like her own daughter.

nodes.headline: Homecoming at Dawn
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Julian arrives at the lakeside gate—and together you clear the last shadow from the estate.

nodes.text: 5:55 AM · Julian steps out of his car on the wet gravel drive and pulls you into a fierce, relieved embrace.
I’m never leaving you alone with unreliable staff again, Elise. Our new legal director starts at 9 AM and every lock has been upgraded.
Good. And let’s plant a fresh lotus bed where Dr. Vance’s SUV tore up the marsh bank.

nodes.prompt: Pale pink dawn breaks across the mirror-calm lake:

options.label: Walk down to the wooden dock together
options.player_reply_text: Let’s watch the mist lift off the water before the sun hits the roof.

options.label: Review the new estate security charter
options.player_reply_text: Let’s sign the new trust charter at sunrise so the Lakeside Villa stays protected for generations.

nodes.text: Golden ripples spread across the quiet lake as morning birds begin to sing.
Signed and sealed—with only honest names on the page.

nodes.headline: Golden Water
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning sunlight bathes the Lakeside Villa in warmth and peace.

nodes.text: 6:55 AM · Brilliant morning sunlight pours across the Lakeside Villa terrace. The crimson eclipse is gone—leaving a crystal-blue sky.
Prosecutor’s office just emailed: all three conspirators remain locked up without bail, and Dr. Vance’s medical license is permanently revoked.
Justice served before breakfast. Pass the warm croissants, Julian.

nodes.prompt: You look out across the sparkling golden water:

options.label: Enjoy a peaceful morning by the lake
options.player_reply_text: No more schemes, no more shadows—just bright mornings ahead.

options.label: Toast to the Matriarch’s watchful love
options.player_reply_text: To your mother—for always keeping the gates safe for the people who truly belong here.

nodes.text: Sunlight shimmers across the lotus marsh as warm breeze rustles the willow trees along the shore.
Porcelain cups clink gently in the warm golden sun.

nodes.headline: Dawn at Lakeside Villa
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The Karma Contract of the Midnight Villa"! Explore more karma thrillers.
